objective: Recover every historically failed/rejected/exhausted XAU strategy identity or configuration family and retest each exactly on 2018-2024, then apply the frozen IPS v2 confirmation layer without changing base economics.

include: every strategy/candidate that received REJECTED, failed Gate A/B/Supergate, BRANCH_EXHAUSTED after economic testing, or observational-reserve classification caused by failed gates
every frozen profile/configuration inside a rejected family when its exact identity is recoverable
historical transfer strategies to XAU whose XAU decision was negative
invalidated historical candidates only as INVALIDATED_NOT_ELIGIBLE unless a corrected exact implementation is recoverable
exclude: approved M1-M4 parents except as reference controls
campaigns with zero PnL trials and BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE only
PREREGISTERED_NO_RESULTS universes not yet economically failed
indicators that were not trading strategies

uniform_ips_filter.rule: Keep a reproduced base trade only if a same-direction frozen IPS event with score>=65 occurred strictly before the base entry, within 60 minutes, on the same source day.

serial_execution.priority_rule: historical chronology of terminal decisions, with exact-recoverable identities executed when reached; unrecoverable identities are checkpointed BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE and the queue continues
serial_execution.dedupe: exact aliases first, then semantic/causal aliases; aliases remain in census but are not counted as independent alpha

base_reproduction_gate.authority_matching: exact trade-by-trade parity when a frozen ledger exists; otherwise exact generator/source hash plus every recoverable frozen golden metric/count

descendant_gate.note: A base strategy that was historically rejected never changes its old decision. A passing IPS combination is a new descendant and requires later independent validation.

multiplicity.family_configurations: all recoverable configurations are accounted for; causal/semantic duplicates do not receive independent multiplicity credit

future_policy.2025_2026: not used in this 2018-2024 retrospective campaign
future_policy.validation_of_successful_descendant: must be separately preregistered on genuinely independent evidence; historically exposed years stay EXPOSED
